items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: He used to be around with all of us. Is he still living? He's still living. He's still living. They tell me he's living, tell me he's looking all right.

ctx.x: He used to be around with all of us. Is he still living? He's still living. He's still living. They tell me he's living, tell me he's looking all right.
He's an old man named One Us, you know.

Yeah, well, I find him and could have interviewed with him. Yeah, and we had Rodgers. Ernest Rodgers. Ernest Rodgers on snare drum with us. Yeah, and we had Rodgers on snare drum with us. Yeah, and we had Rodgers. Ernest Rodgers on snare drum with us. He died three years ago or two years ago this September.
